verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on NVIDIA's developer portal, which covers the CUDA and AI developer docs that apply to this GPU, so an agent has an agent-oriented entry point. It is portal-wide rather than specific to the RTX 5070 Ti, and the markdown version of the CUDA toolkit page returns 404. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-oriented docs, working per-page markdown docs (cuda-toolkit.md 404), and hands-on or independent confirmation of the llms.txt contents and usefulness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
